messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Duplicate loss reports create multiple claims without any warning or ability to link them.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-10-31T11:19:00+00:00",
   "quote": "We’re seeing a duplicate loss report scenario where the same incident comes in via phone and portal, creating two claims without any intake warning — we’ve even spotted disabled UI buttons that should allow linking but don’t work.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-28T14:41:00+00:00",
   "quote": "When a policyholder reports the same incident both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t alert us — it just creates two separate claims, which is a classic duplicate loss report scenario and causes confusion in reserves and reporting.",
   "route": "onboarding"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-18T15:03:00+00:00",
   "quote": "we’ve had several instances where the same loss gets reported twice — once by phone, once via web — and the system doesn’t warn us...the system doesn’t show any warning at intake, which leads to duplicate records and inaccurate reserves.",
   "route": "onboarding"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-06T16:28:00Z",
   "quote": "the same incident came in both by phone and web portal, and now we’ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it — that’s what we’re calling a duplicate loss report, and it’s messing up our reserves and supplier coordination.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-12T14:28:00+00:00",
   "quote": "We’ve seen the same loss reported through two channels — phone and web — and no system warning appeared, creating a duplicate loss report that complicates our reserves and payments.",
   "route": "support"
  }
 ],
 "title": "Duplicate loss reports create multiple claims without any warning or ability to"
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that duplicate loss reports (same incident via phone and portal) create multiple claims with no intake warning and no working ability to link them. All five quotes across support, onboarding, and sales consistently describe missing duplicate detection at intake and even disabled UI buttons for linking claims. This is squarely a product behavior a squad could address (duplicate detection, linking functionality), not pricing, customer IT, or a help-article issue. No praise or out-of-scope causes appear in the evidence.","verdict": "pass"}
